editorial:
Ever wonder what happens behind the scenes of a massive political campaign? You get a front-row seat to the chaos in this documentary. It follows a group of wealthy political donors who decide that Dr. Ben Carson is the perfect man to save the Republican Party. They put all their money and hope into him, treating him like a superstar who can win it all. The vibe feels like a high-stakes gamble where the players are convinced they have a winning hand, but they are completely out of their depth when the real world hits them.

What really makes this work is watching the slow crash as Carson's lack of political experience leads to embarrassing mistakes on live TV. You can feel the panic as the money dries up and the donors start to turn on each other. The pacing keeps you hooked because it feels like a ticking time bomb. If you like political drama, you should definitely check this out. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with the total collapse of the campaign. You see the PACmen realize that their dream of a Carson presidency was never realistic. As Donald Trump takes over the spotlight, the donors are left broke and embarrassed. The final scenes show them questioning their own judgment and admitting they picked the wrong person. It ends on a sad note, showing how ego and money can blind people to the truth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing how power and money work in politics.
